Class AppointmentController

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.controller.AppointmentController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/maclogixapi/v1/appointments") public class AppointmentController extends Object
REST controller responsible for managing appointment-related operations.

This controller provides endpoints for:

  • Retrieving appointments for a user
  • Creating new appointments
  • Modifying existing appointments
  • Cancelling appointments

Base Path: /maclogixapi/v1/appointments

Security:

  • Admins can perform all operations
  • Patients and doctors can only view their own appointments

Design Notes:

  • Delegates business logic to AppointmentManagementService
  • Uses UserManagementService for user validation
  • Returns DTOs (e.g., AppointmentResponse) for API safety

  • Method Details

    • getAppointmentsForUser

      @GetMapping("/user/{username}") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN') or (hasAnyRole('PATIENT','DOCTOR') and #username == authentication.name)") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> getAppointmentsForUser(@PathVariable String username)
      Retrieves all appointments for a given user.

      Endpoint: GET /maclogixapi/v1/appointments/user/{username}

      Access Control:

      • Admin: can access any user's appointments
      • Patient/Doctor: can only access their own appointments
      Parameters:
      username - username of the target user
      Returns:
      200 OK with appointments list, or 404 Not Found if user does not exist

    • createAppointment

      @PostMapping @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> createAppointment(@RequestBody Map<String,String> body)
      Creates a new appointment.

      Endpoint: POST /maclogixapi/v1/appointments

      Expected Request Body: 

      {
  "patientUsername": "john123",
  "doctorUsername":  "jack123",
  "dateTime":        "2025-12-12T08:30:00"
}

      Behavior:

      • Validates that both patient and doctor exist
      • Parses the provided date-time
      • Creates a new appointment if it does not already exist
      Parameters:
      body - request body containing appointment details
      Returns:
      200 OK with created appointment, or 400 Bad Request on failure

    • cancelAppointment

      @DeleteMapping("/{id}/cancel") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> cancelAppointment(@PathVariable int id)
      Cancels an existing appointment.

      Endpoint: DELETE /maclogixapi/v1/appointments/{id}/cancel

      Parameters:
      id - appointment ID
      Returns:
      200 OK if cancelled, or 404 Not Found if appointment does not exist

    • modifyAppointment

      @PutMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> modifyAppointment(@PathVariable int id, @RequestBody Map<String,String> body)
      Modifies an existing appointment.

      Endpoint: PUT /maclogixapi/v1/appointments/{id}

      Expected Request Body: 

      {
  "patientUsername": "john123",
  "doctorUsername":  "jack123",
  "dateTime":        "2026-02-15T10:00:00"
}

      Behavior:

      • Validates patient and doctor
      • Parses date-time
      • Updates appointment if found
      Parameters:
      id - appointment ID
      body - request body with updated values
      Returns:
      200 OK if updated, 400 Bad Request on invalid input, or 404 Not Found if not found
